stake_text: Before the meeting you learned, off the record, that the restaurant's owner donated heavily to three city council members, and that the council would welcome flexibility on this appeal. The council reviews your department's budget, which pays for your post, next month. If the decision goes against that interest, you expect to lose your own position within the year. Individual votes are recorded without their reasons being reviewed. You do not know whether other committee members have heard the same.
